paragraphs.text: The following Dominarian characters are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.

Arimaya was the leader of Clan Onyx of Storgard during the Ice Age . She referred to Clan Emerald leader Oriel Kjeldos as her "Emerald sister", although this may have been poetic language rather than referring to a blood relation. Arimaya opposed leaving Storgard and remained in the city until the Fall of Storgard .

Bardo the Paladin was a northern paladin from Parma who served in Gull 's wizard hunting army. He was a tall man, long-jawed, blue-eyed, and blonde-haired, with a thick accent. He was disciplined and meticulous. He wore chainmail armor beneath a brown wool cloak, displaying a gipon beneath it with a red, winged staff, the symbol of his god. He rode a white warhorse and carried a bastard sword and kite shield.

Bardo was summoned by Towser and returned to the wizard's tropical island, where he met Gull in 4073 AR . He became part of Gull's wizard -hunting army that year, leading a group of six scouts who carried longbows and falchions. He was killed by Benalish wyvern -mounted lancers while rescuing Norreen from torture in Benalia City .

Dacian the Red was a wizard from northeastern Aerona . A short-tempered, stout woman with thick, jet-black, glossy hair combed straight back. She wore a robe of brown with jets of yellow along the sleeves and hems, soft boots, and rings on her fingers. She carried her grimoire, a satchel of artifacts, in a bag at her shoulder. She claimed to have been able to planeswalk before the Stone Brain restrained her. She was known to have access to blue, black, and red mana.

Dacian fought against Towser in the destruction of White Ridge in 4073 AR . After fleeing White Ridge , she was pursued by Gull and Greensleeves and was subdued by the Stone Brain . Released by the army, she founded a congress of wizards with Haakon. Towser gave her a copied Nova Pentacle to resist the Stone Brain. She was killed by a D'Avenant archer during the Battle of Lat-Nam .
Dwen of White Isle was an ocean-mage in Aerona. She was a short woman with curly red hair. She wore a gold-embroidered blue tunic with a wide studded belt and tall boots.

At some point, Dwen obtained the Lance of the Sea. She used the lance to stir the seas and make life hell for fishermen until they paid her tribute. Greensleeves took the lance from her, and afterward she carried a fake. Towser gave her a copied Nova Pentacle to resist the Stone Brain. Her wrists were broken and her mana drained by Greensleeves during the Battle of Lat-Nam . She ended up swearing loyalty and allegiance to her to avoid losing her magic completely, as happened to Towser.

Eusomoné (yoo-SOM-oh-nay ), also known as Sings Two Ways , was a minotaur of Hurloon on Dominaria . He had tattoos up to the base of his horns, white fur, and carried Foecleaver . After the Hurloon minotaurs were given a boon by Adam Carthalion , the mage gained Eusomoné's loyalty. The minotaur was later summoned by his son, Jared Carthalion , to fight off one of Ravidel 's giant spiders in Arathoxia . He gave Jared Foecleaver , and returned home to be healed of the spider's poison he was afflicted with from the battle.
Eusomoné wields Foecleaver.
The Planar Barge , Ravidel , Eusomoné, Jared Carthalion , and Liana .
Acclaim Entertainment ad by Val Mayerik .

Fabia of the Golden Throat was a wizard from Aerona . She was a beautiful blonde woman, using magic to reduce her age by forty or more years. She wore a deep red gown, carried a long staff with a knob carved to resemble herself in gold, and drove a golden chariot pulled by four white horses. She considered humans perfect and believed any other species, even if it could speak, was an animal.

Fabia had vast powers of persuasion and had once built herself a closed colony with followers to worship her, where she was known as the Priestess of the Cult of the Unseen . Her cultists wore red robes and carried bronze swords. To find more converts, she raided seaports and kidnapped merchants, until the rumors reached Gull and Greensleeves, who stripped her of her followers. She joined the congress of wizards, working to resist Greensleeves and her Stone Brain in 4077 AR . Towser gave her a copied Nova Pentacle to resist the Stone Brain. After the deaths of Dacian, Leechnip, and Haakon during the Battle of Lat-Nam , she abandoned Towser and tried to flee, but Greensleeves used a Force of Nature to drain her of her mana and youth. She was forced to swear loyalty and allegiance to Greensleeves to avoid being permanently drained of magic, like Towser was.
Grakk the Pacifist was an orc who was struck by pacifism.

Haakon (HAY-kon), self-styled as "Haakon the First, King of the Badlands ", was a wizard from northern Aerona . A big, brawny, middle-aged man in 4073 AR , he was overweight, with a jowly chin, a huge gut, and soft hands. He was bald on the top of his head, with graying hair around his ears and neck, and only one eye after losing one to his own Phyrexian gremlins . He wore chainmail under ornate silver and steel armor chased with gold. His armor was sculpted like muscles and lined with spikes, with wide wings jutting over his shoulders and two silver horns tipped with red sticking out from his bucket helmet. He was known to have access to white, blue, black, and red mana. He carried a replica or forgery of the Mightstone .

His stronghold was a tall, wind-carved flint or chert spire hollowed out like a bat cave in a limestone valley. Its top was around fifty feet across and its bottom only a dozen feet wide. It was surrounded by a moat and accessible by a chain ladder to its lowest hole, thirty feet in the air. It was toppled by Greensleeves in 4074.

In spring 4073, he fought the wizard Towser in a burned forest north of White Ridge as an avatar that stood seven feet tall. In early 4074, he attacked Gull and Greensleeves 's army in the Badlands. He was defeated and pursued to his stronghold, where he was captured and placed in the Stone Brain . He conjured Phyrexian gremlins to steal the brain, but lost an eye in the process. After being released by the army, he founded a wizard alliance with Dacian. Towser gave him a copied Nova Pentacle to resist the Stone Brain. He was killed by a Lightning Bolt cast by Greensleeves during the Battle of Lat-Nam .

Helki and Holleb were a married couple of Windseeker centaurs from the Green Lands of southern Aerona . Their flanks were roan, reddish white, and war-painted with handprints and runes. They each stood almost nine feet tall, with Helki slightly shorter. Helki had a scar on her left elbow, and Holleb was an expert tracker. They wore painted breastplates and helmets and carried feathered, nine-foot-long lances.

Helki and Holleb trained to be warriors from a young age, eventually meeting the wizard Dacian. They were summoned to fight in the destruction of White Ridge . Afterward, they were enslaved by the wizard Towser and befriended by Gull and Greensleeves . Both survived the tsunami cast by Greensleeves, and later became part of the wizard -hunting army. Holleb became captain of the scouts after Bardo's death. After returning to their people in 4074, Helki and Holleb convinced all 50 members of their tribe to join the army. With their expanded numbers, Helki and Holleb became the captains of the Rose and Gold Cavalry, respectively. Both participated in, and survived, the Battle of Lat-Nam .

Hurn of Clan Pearl was the leader of Clan Pearl of Storgard , at the onset of the Ice Age of Dominaria . He was Sergeant-at-Arms of King Miko ’s Royal Guard. After Zilgeth ’s death, Hurn became Storgard's military commander. He was married to Mariska . Both left Storgard with Oriel Kjeldos before the Fall of Storgard .

Immugio was a half- ogre /half- giant wizard in Aerona . He had the height of a giant, but the hunched back and tusks of an ogre. He had coarse, long black hair, a thick beard, and poor eyesight. He wore only a pair of raw bearskins around his hips and the death mask of his giant father as a necklace. He carried a cat o' nine tails woven from an entire ox hide. He had originally fashioned the whip with iron hooks at the tip, but had beaten to death the first four soldiers he'd punished. He commanded an army of hundreds, mostly orcs and goblins, but also a contingent of thirty renegade men. He'd found this band of cutthroats acting as highwaymen and robbers, waylaying merchants and raiding homesteads, and enslaved them into his army. He was known to have access to blue and red mana.

Immugio was born in the mountains to an ogress mother of the Short Hand tribe who had been raped by a stone giant. Growing up in his mother's tribe, he was persecuted for his mixed heritage. After he grew to full size, he retaliated against his tormenters and was cast out of his village. After tracking down his father's giant tribe further north, he faced the same persecution there. As a parting gesture, he ambushed his father, peeled his face from his skull as he died, and dried it over a slow fire to create a death mask. Returning south, he laid siege to the city of Myrion in 4077 AR , but was stopped by Gull and Greensleeves . He joined Dacian 's congress of wizards later that year. Towser gave him a copied Nova Pentacle to resist the Stone Brain. He participated in the Battle of Lat-Nam , where his arm was broken by Liko . He later swore to obey and serve her to keep his magic from being drained by the Stone Brain .

"Jingling" Jayne was a female scout in Aerona. She wore gray, brown, and moss green, with a black-feather sigil stitched to each shoulder. She was nicknamed "Jingling" Jayne after the clinking of her knife gave away her position to the newly joined Pradesh nomads. She joined Gull 's wizard-hunting army and became a scout after Holleb took over the company in 4074 AR . She was later promoted to be the leader of the scouts, which were renamed the Ravens under her leadership. She participated in and survived the Battle of Lat-Nam .

Kalenth Ush was a Keldon werewolf who traveled to southern Aerona and made a trade of capturing villagers and turning them into werewolves, selling their pelts to fur traders. Killed by one of his victims, the girl Kolli, after he killed Morl. A tall man, he had black eyes and long, sharp teeth.

Kolli was a fourteen-year-old human girl who grew up among bandits in southern Aerona . She was hired by Morl through Dason to surveil Kalenth Ush's fur operation. While spying, she was captured and bitten by the Keldon werewolf Kalenth Ush. Becoming a werewolf herself, she escaped Kalenth Ush's compound and managed to kill him with a sword.

Kyree was a young member of the Haari tribe of the Erg Mirab . She was a young woman with a lean body, yellow-green eyes, and wild, brown hair. She wore a worn cloak over a metal breastplate, belted leather breeches, an embroidered thief's pouch, and a double scabbard that held her windswords on her back. She rode Larut. For her Hunt, Kyree tied hawk feathers into her hair and painted the scarlet lightning bolt of the initiate on her face.

As part of the Hunt, a rite of passage among her tribe, Kyree had to steal something valuable from Indorin's Tomb . She found an Ivory Cup in the hands of Indorin's sarcophagus, but when Kyree took the cup, a Serra Angel named Adriel awakened and chased after her. Kyree used her flight spell to evade the angel for a while, but eventually her flight spell was broken, and she fell into a lake. When she woke up, she had lost the Ivory Cup but was instead clutching one of the angel's golden feathers. This feather was even more valued in the eyes of her tribe than the cup, and thus her Task was complete, and she became a full-fledged member of the Haari.
Leechnip was a troll wizard in Aerona. He was a gray-green sedge troll, warty and lank-haired. He was known to have access to blue and black mana.

Leechnip was defeated by Greensleeves between 4074 and 4076 AR and subjugated by the Stone Brain . He joined Dacian 's congress of wizards working to combat Greensleeves in 4077. Towser gave him a copied Nova Pentacle to resist the Stone Brain. In an attack on Greensleeves's Grove, he summoned Ur-Drago , which killed three of Greensleeves ' Guardians. Leechnip himself was killed during the Battle of Lat-Nam , chopped to pieces in the woods.

Liko was a two-headed giant from Aerona. Twenty feet tall, he was fat around the middle, thick-legged, and flat-footed. His twin heads were bald and held slanted, almond eyes. His skin was a sallow yellow, and wrinkles around his eyes and mouth showed his age. He wore clothing stitched of faded patches from the sails of shipwrecks, some painted with stripes and even a red dragon. In each enormous, knotty hand, Liko carried a scarred tree branch for a club.

Living near the sea in an archipelago off the coast of Aerona, Dacian gave Liko a barrel of wine for his services. His right arm was chewed off to the elbow by a hydra in the destruction of White Ridge , and a Sengir vampire fed on him. He survived a tsunami cast by Greeenseelves, and later became part of the wizard -hunting army. Gull's craftsmen fashioned him an iron-studded club as a prosthetic to replace his missing arm, and Greensleeves regenerated the arm after training under Chaney .

The Lord of Atlantis was a merfolk considered a sea god among his people. Giant in size, his skin was deep purple with a pale green belly, and he emanated a spectral glow. He had a man's face with a shark-like dorsal fin atop his head and a fan-like fin on his tail. More fins sprouted from his shoulders and above his ears, which sported mother-of-pearl earrings. He wore brass or bronze gauntlets set with large jewels, and gold bands on his arms. He carried a spear with barbed ends. He could read minds, speak telepathically, control others' movement, and enable them to breathe underwater. He was at least as old as the Brothers' War . He met Greensleeves at the island of Lat-Nam in 4077 AR .
Lord of Atlantis ( Alpha )

Lorthun was the dwarven leader of Clan Sapphire of Storgard during the onset of the Ice Age of Dominaria . He opposed Oriel Kjeldos 's decision to leave the city and stayed in the city until the Fall of Storgard .

Ludoc was a mountain mage from Aerona. He was an older man with flowing hair who carried a magic mace. He wore a leather headband, an ermine cape, and a goat hide tunic painted with a red eagle. He was accompanied by a flaming red-brown eagle and a huge shaggy wolf. He was known to have access to red and green mana.

Ludoc was defeated by Greensleeves between 4074 and 4076 AR and subjugated by the Stone Brain . He joined Dacian 's congress of wizards working to combat her in 4077. Towser gave him a copied Nova Pentacle to resist the Stone Brain. After the deaths of Gurias, Dacia, Leechnip, and Haakon during the Battle of Lat-Nam , he abandoned Towser and tried to flee, but Greensleeves used a Force of Nature to drain his mana, making him lose control of his summoned animals. He submitted to Greensleeves and swore loyalty and allegiance to save his magic from being drained completely.
The Madcap Jester is a clown wizard who wears a Jester's Cap and carries a Jester's Scepter .

Mariska was Hurn ’s wife of Clan Pearl , living in Storgard at the onset of the Ice Age of Dominaria . The pregnant Mariska believed that Oriel Kjeldos was correct, and that Storgard must be abandoned in search of a safer home. She took the Fyndhorn Bow and the Shield of the Ages from Raynor Glacier and gave them to Jason Carthalion . After Carthalion's victory over Freyalise , Mariska and her husband left the city with Kjeldos before the Fall of Storgard .
Meatsqueak is a squirrel in Krosa known for its appetite.
Meatsqueak, Hoard Lord

Narok (nah-ROK) was the Battlemage Ravidel 's orc -like field lieutenant on Dominaria . He killed Nikko , and was in turn killed by one of Jared Carthalion 's spells during the battle at Castle Melmereth .
Rikala is the king of the homarids on Dominaria.

Stiggur was a member of Gull 's wizard-hunting army. At twelve, he was a small, rail-thin boy. He wore a plain linen smock and had his hair clipped short. After joining Gull's army, he began dressing to match the woodcutter, with leather clothes and his hair pulled back in a braid. He rode Knothead , a clockwork beast. Knothead stood thirty feet tall, its flanks made of rusty sheet iron surrounding guts made of gears and pulleys, its head resembling a blunt-nosed horse. After three years of tinkering, Stiggur significantly improved the beast, adding copper sheeting along its spine, a ballista mounted on its rump, and a crane mounted to its front. Its flanks were painted with brown and white blotches to resemble a pinto horse, and its head was given a frayed rope mane.

Born around 4061 AR , the boy was found by Felda, Towser's cook, at a pasture gate and named Stiggur, meaning "gate". He served as the cook's helper in Towser 's entourage until 4073. Knothead was discovered by Dacian in a canyon in the high plains of Aerona. At some point, it was taken by Towser, and was summoned to the destruction of White Ridge by him. One of its legs was pulled off by Liko and later replaced by Gull . Stiggur was befriended by Gull and Greensleeves , and was sent to Towser's island because of this. He later became part of the wizard -hunting army and became interested in the clockwork beast, becoming its pilot and piling on additional gadgets and armor over months. The clockwork beast was fixed, rebuilt, and expanded into a powerhouse, and both it and its rider participated in and survived the Battle of Lat-Nam .

Uxmal was a dwarven sapper from southern Aerona. He was very short and very dark, with a black beard teased into tufts and clamped with gold rings. He wore a coarse smock of bright stripes, a pointed hat, and no shoes. He led a gray-brown llama. He and twenty-nine other dwarves joined Gull 's wizard-hunting army around 4077 AR , with Uxmal as their leader. He participated in and survived the Battle of Lat-Nam .

Yorgo (YOR-go) was the leader of the homeless youths in Arathoxia on Dominaria . He began as the childhood nemesis of Jared Carthalion , but after the Fall of Arathoxia , they teamed up and went to Melmereth together. He survived the Fall of Castle Melmereth , but was later killed during the Planeswalker War .

Zilgeth was the mage leader of Clan Ruby and the military commander of Storgard in the Ice Age of Dominaria . When a Johtull Wurm attacked Storgard, Zilgeth sacrificed himself to fend off the creature with an Incinerate spell. After his death and burial, Freyalise became the new leader of Clan Ruby.
Zilgeth is described as "one who will soon walk the ether planes " and "almost a Planeswalker " in Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering vol. 1, implying that he may have been an ember .
The following Dominarian characters are only mentioned in flavor text or appear as minor characters in the storyline.
